messages:
Tom (Sales Eng): Kicking off a POC with AtlasPay — they want streaming txs -> our SDK, plus tool calls for enrichment and strict JSON schema enforcement. CTO needs procurement-ready security answers. Ping @Jaya @Kofi.
Jaya (Solutions): We support streaming (py/js/go/rust). Use the schema param; validation is server-side and returns structured errors with json paths. Works with tool calls; respondTool injects output back into session.
Tom (Sales Eng): Can we give a tiny Node example and notes on schema mismatch behavior?
Jaya (Solutions): Quick snippet:
```js
const s = client.stream({model:'tx-stream',schema})
await s.send({txId:'t1',amt:100})
for await (const e of s.recv()) { if (e.type==='structured_output') handle(e.json); if (e.type==='tool_call') { const res = await callEnrich(e.args); await s.respondTool(e.callId,res); } }
```
Jaya (Solutions): On mismatch: default = reject + structured error. Lenient mode returns partial+warnings (not for ledgers).
Kofi (Presales): POC path: hosted demo fastest. 2-week POC ballpark $2k-5k. Dedicated needs 4w lead. Recommend reserved burst for backfill and batching.
Elena (Security): I'll prepare a one-pager: regions, KMS, TLS, SSO/SAML, audit exports, SOC2 contact. Ask them to send the XLSX.
infra-bot: Demo env ready demo.redwood.ai/atlaspay-02 — creds DMed to Tom.
Tom (Sales Eng): Thanks — scheduling a 30m tech call tomorrow 11am PT to review SDK, schema, and security Qs.
